WHAT'S LIVE

Every change to the model that is live on the boards but still provisional: what it does, the setting it runs on today, and the rule that decides whether it stays.

The settings are read from the code each time this page is built, so they are what the boards are running. The rules were written before each test and are judged in the January rechecks (new keep rule) run on Jan 11, 2027.

NFLGame model

Offensive-line names matched loosely

Live since Nov 11, 2026 · Ryan's call after a flat test

A lineman the snap counts, roster and injury report spell differently (a dropped "Jr.", "DJ" for "Delmar") no longer counts as missing every week.

Setting now

injuries.ALIAS_GROUPS
("ol",)
nflmodel/injuries.py

To turn it off: Set injuries.ALIAS_GROUPS = ().

What decides it

Removed if worse on 2026 alone (experiments/ol_name_match_test.py).

Judged on: The 2026 season, with the PFF data.

PFF passing grade and opponent coverage in passing yards

Live since Nov 13, 2026 · Kept under the rule; Ryan's go-ahead

The quarterback's PFF passing grade and the opponent's PFF coverage grade are extra terms in the passing-yards calibration.

Setting now

["wind", "pff_pass_grade", "pff_opp_cov"]

NFLGame model

Friday weight for current-line games

Live since Nov 19, 2026 · Ryan's call on a trade-off

Games priced at the current line use the weight the model earns with Friday information (0.156 for 2026) in place of the game-day weight (0.290). Early lines and the final week are unchanged.

Setting now

FRIDAY_WEIGHT
True
nflmodel/config.py

To turn it off: Set FRIDAY_WEIGHT = False.

What decides it

Comes off if that stretch is worse on average miss. Within 1 standard error either way, it stays and is judged again after 2027.

Judged on: NFL games kicked off after Nov 19, 2026, from the forecast log's logged inputs.

  • claude/nfl-friday-weight-test-results-2026-11-19.md
  • FEATURES.md, “Bet-time information: the Friday weight”

Model nudge on Parlays main-line legs

Live since Nov 13, 2026 · Ryan's call on a 19-of-20 trade-off

Two-sided college main lines on the Parlays page are priced part of the way from the books' number to the model's, up to a cap. Value is still scored on the books' number.

Setting now

CFB_W_MAIN
0.2
nflmodel/parlays.py
CFB_PULL_MAX
0.03
nflmodel/parlays.py
CFB_NUDGE_STATS
("pass_yds", "pass_td", "rush_yds", "rec_yds")
nflmodel/parlays.py

To turn it off: A stat comes off through CFB_NUDGE_STATS.

What decides it

Removed if the 2026 all-stats Brier is worse than the books. If all-stats is better but one stat is worse by more than 1 standard error, that stat comes off and it goes to Ryan. Same weight and cap: no refit on 2026.

Judged on: The full 2026 season's logged chances (through Nov 12 was read when it was applied).

CollegeGame model

Market-residual margin

Live since Nov 19, 2026 · Ryan's call on an 11-of-12 trade-off

The adjusted college spread is the line plus a ridge fit of (result − line) on the margin inputs and the line, recent seasons weighted more, in place of one blend weight. Early lines and totals are unchanged.

Setting now

STACK_MARGIN
True
cfbmodel/config.py
STACK_ALPHA
500.0
cfbmodel/config.py
STACK_HALF_LIFE
4.0
cfbmodel/config.py

To turn it off: Set STACK_MARGIN = False (restores the blend weight).

What decides it

Comes off if the post-Nov 19 average miss or RMS miss is worse. A mixed result on side win rate or bet-time miss goes to Ryan. No refit of the penalty or half-life on 2026.

Judged on: College games kicked off after Nov 19, 2026 (about 300 with bowls).

  • CFB_FEATURES.md, “Market-residual margin”

BothProps

Role change in the prop spread

Live since Nov 17, 2026 · Ryan's call; the two pieces that nearly passed, by stat

The spread of a prop's distribution widens after a role change: NFL receptions and receiving yards (WR, TE, RB) and college carries and rushing yards (RB).

Setting now

rolechange.APPLIED
{"nfl": [("receptions", "WR"), ("receptions", "TE"), ("receptions", "RB"), ("rec_yds", "WR"), ("rec_yds", "TE"), ("rec_yds", "RB")], "cfb": [("carries", "RB"), ("rush_yds", "RB")]}
nflmodel/rolechange.py

To turn it off: Empty the league's list in rolechange.APPLIED and refit the prop parameters.

What decides it

A piece comes off if 2026 is worse on its main lines (game-day and bet-time) or on its floor rungs. Anything mixed goes to Ryan.

Judged on: The 2026 season (the stat split was chosen after seeing 2017-2025).

KEPT UNDER THE EARLIER RULE

Both

Everything kept Nov 4 to Nov 10, 2026 under the old "any improvement" rule

Kept with no noise threshold, on seasons the tests had seen. Named in the rechecks list as: the Nov 4 college and NFL game-model additions, PFF route share, the PFF quarterback prior, transfer-aware returning production, the quarterback rushing and kneel-down changes, the Questionable shades, the over-lean shade, and the rest dated Nov 4 on in FEATURES.md, CFB_FEATURES.md, PLAYERS.md and PROPS.md.

What decides them: Each is judged on the 2026 season alone, the only season none of them was chosen on, and removed if worse there. Player changes are scored on bet-time projections as well as game-day ones.

These are not itemised with their settings yet. The January task works from the four test logs.
